tests.report:
Feature: Confirming the first train starts its calibration
Expected: The dialog now asks the user to place the second train ('Bahn 2') on the calibration point
Observed failure: I opened the app and the "Ersteinrichtung" dialog showed "Bitte Bahn 1 auf den Kalibrierpunkt stellen." with the button "Bahn 1 steht am Kalibrierpunkt". My first click failed because the element reference had gone stale when the dialog re-rendered. A click by role and name on the same button then worked. After waiting 25 seconds, the new accessibility snapshot showed the dialog still reading "Bahn 1 wird kalibriert …". It did not ask for Bahn 2 to be placed on the calibration point, and no button for Bahn 2 was present. Calibration did start, but after 25 seconds the dialog had not moved on to the second train.
Steps completed before failure: 4

Feature: Completing the setup in one frontend completes it in all frontends
Expected: In both tabs the calibration dialog is gone and the Start button is enabled, and the track graphic shows markers for both 'Bahn 1' and 'Bahn 2'
Observed failure: I opened the app and then a second tab, and in the second tab clicked "Bahn 2 steht am Kalibrierpunkt". The first two click attempts used element refs that had gone stale and did not register; the third click, by button text, worked. After waiting 25 seconds, the second tab's dialog "Ersteinrichtung" was gone, but the Start button was still disabled, and so were "+ Haltestelle hinzufügen" and "Alle Strecken zurücksetzen". Its track graphic had no "Bahn 1" or "Bahn 2" markers, and its console showed 1 error. A later snapshot of the second tab, taken without reloading, was unchanged. In the first tab, which I switched to without reloading, the dialog was gone, Start was enabled, and the track graphic showed markers for "Bahn 1" (near Weiche 1) and "Bahn 2" (at the Kalibrierpunkt), confirmed by screenshot. So the setup only fully completed in the tab where the button was not clicked.
Steps completed before failure: 5

Feature: Start locks the editing
Expected: The status badge shows 'In Fahrt', a red Stop button is shown instead of the Start button, the stops cannot be changed, added or removed (instead of 'Haltestelle hinzufügen' there is a disabled button 'Während der Fahrt gesperrt'), and 'Alle Strecken zurücksetzen' is disabled
Observed failure: I set Bahn 1 to 1. Haltestelle 2, 2. Haltestelle 4 and Bahn 2 to 1. Haltestelle 4, 2. Haltestelle 2, then clicked the Start button. The app did not start. In the new accessibility snapshot the status badge still shows 'Gestoppt' and the Start button is still there, with no Stop button. An alert says "Die sichere Steuerung ist noch nicht verfügbar." The Haltestelle dropdowns, the remove (×) buttons, '+ Haltestelle hinzufügen' and 'Alle Strecken zurücksetzen' are all still enabled, so editing was never locked. Because the run never started, the lock could not be tested further. The action budget was also used up at this point.
Steps completed before failure: 6

Feature: Start makes the locomotives drive
Expected: Both histories contain entries with a speed higher than the calibration speed (the train's normal speed) and the direction forward; at least one train currently has a speed greater than 0; apart from the calibration speed, each train uses only one non-zero speed value
Observed failure: The app opened with the status "Gestoppt". The stop lists were already correct (Bahn 1: Haltestelle 2, Haltestelle 4; Bahn 2: Haltestelle 4, Haltestelle 2), so I changed nothing. I clicked Start (around 08:28:38), waited 15 seconds and opened the mock server console. Neither locomotive received any new message after the click: the newest log entry is from 08:20:40, before the test began. Both trains show Speed 0. Bahn 2's history is only "60 forward → 0 forward", which is just the calibration run, with no entry above the calibration speed. Bahn 1's history ("60 backward → 0 backward → 120 forward → 0 forward") contains only entries from 08:18, before the test. When I reloaded the app afterwards it still showed "Gestoppt" and an empty Betriebsprotokoll, so Start had no visible effect.
Steps completed before failure: 6

Feature: Train positions move live in the preview
Expected: At least one train marker is at a clearly different place on the track in the second screenshot
Observed failure: Both stop lists were already correct, so no changes were needed: Bahn 1 had Haltestelle 2, Haltestelle 4 and Bahn 2 had Haltestelle 4, Haltestelle 2. I clicked Start and the app showed the error toast "Die sichere Steuerung ist noch nicht verfügbar." The status badge stayed "Gestoppt" and the speed stayed at 0. I took screenshots after waiting 5 s and then 3 s more. In both, the markers were in the same place: Bahn 1 near Weiche 1 on the inner track, Bahn 2 at the Kalibrierpunkt. Neither train moved.
Steps completed before failure: 6

Feature: The trains run around the loop in opposite directions
Expected: Comparing consecutive screenshots, the marker of 'Bahn 1' moves clockwise along the main loop and the marker of 'Bahn 2' moves counter-clockwise; it is sufficient that each train is seen moving in its own sense in at least one pair of consecutive screenshots; the two trains do not circle the loop in the same sense
Observed failure: The status badge showed "Gestoppt" and both stop lists were already correct (Bahn 1: Haltestelle 2, Haltestelle 4; Bahn 2: Haltestelle 4, Haltestelle 2). I clicked Start and the app showed the error toast "Die sichere Steuerung ist noch nicht verfügbar." The status stayed "Gestoppt" and "Geschwindigkeit" stayed at 0. In three screenshots taken after 10 s, 15 s and 20 s the markers did not move: Bahn 1 stood at Weiche 1 on the bottom straight and Bahn 2 at the calibration point. Neither train moved in any direction and the Betriebsprotokoll stayed empty. The last two wait-and-screenshot steps were not carried out, because the app had refused to start.
Steps completed before failure: 5

Feature: Switches are set while driving
Expected: After Start, new switch changes have been added to the history of 'Weichen', i.e. the app has set switches via the Switch Server while the trains were driving
Observed failure: Before Start, the mock console showed 'Applied switch changes (oldest first)' for 'Weichen' as "none" (positions #0 to #3 all 1 (straight), messages "applied: 2", both of them "no change"). In the app the badge showed "Gestoppt" and both stop lists were already correct (Bahn 1: Haltestelle 2, Haltestelle 4; Bahn 2: Haltestelle 4, Haltestelle 2). I clicked Start (at about 08:31:42), then waited 30 s twice. Back in the mock console, the Weichen column still showed "none", the message counter still read "applied: 2", and all switches were still straight. The newest entry in the whole message log was still from 08:20:40, from before this test. After Start nothing was sent to any server: speeds of Bahn 1 and Bahn 2 stayed 0 and their speed histories did not change. So the app set no switches, and did not drive the trains either, after Start.
Steps completed before failure: 11

Feature: Head-on meeting: one train evades to the siding
Expected: Since the last 'Start' the log contains at least one entry '<train> weicht aus' and, later, an entry '<train> wartet auf dem Ausweichgleis' for the same train: when the trains met head-on, one of them drove back to the siding
Observed failure: The status badge showed "Gestoppt" and both stop lists were already correct (Bahn 1: Haltestelle 2, Haltestelle 4; Bahn 2: Haltestelle 4, Haltestelle 2). I clicked Start and waited 3 × 30 seconds. The new snapshot showed the badge still at "Gestoppt" and "Geschwindigkeit: 0". The 'Betriebsprotokoll' had no entries at all: no 'Start', no 'weicht aus', no 'wartet auf dem Ausweichgleis'. An alert read "Die sichere Steuerung ist noch nicht verfügbar." Start had no effect, the trains never ran and no evasion to the siding took place.
Steps completed before failure: 6

Feature: After a meeting both trains continue (no deadlock)
Expected: Since the last 'Start' the log contains an entry '<train> wartet auf dem Ausweichgleis', later '<train> fährt weiter' for the same train, and after that further entries '… erreicht …' for both 'Bahn 1' and 'Bahn 2': the trains passed each other and both keep reaching their stops
Observed failure: The status badge showed "Gestoppt" and both stop lists were already correct (Bahn 1: Haltestelle 2, Haltestelle 4; Bahn 2: Haltestelle 4, Haltestelle 2). I clicked Start. The app showed the alert "Die sichere Steuerung ist noch nicht verfügbar." The badge stayed "Gestoppt", the speed stayed 0, and the 'Betriebsprotokoll' had no entries at all: no 'Start', no waiting or continuing entries, nothing about reaching a stop. Starting operation has no effect, so the trains never move and never meet. (The tester sent the four 30-second waits in parallel instead of sequentially, then waited another 30 seconds on its own and took a fresh snapshot, which looked the same.)
Steps completed before failure: 6

Feature: Trains never occupy the same place
Expected: In none of the screenshots do the markers of 'Bahn 1' and 'Bahn 2' overlap or stand on the same track section; one train waits or evades while the other passes
Observed failure: The status badge showed "Gestoppt" and both stop lists were already correct (Bahn 1: Haltestelle 2, Haltestelle 4; Bahn 2: Haltestelle 4, Haltestelle 2). Clicking Start did not start the trains; an error toast appeared: "Die sichere Steuerung ist noch nicht verfügbar." The badge stayed "Gestoppt" and both trains showed "Geschwindigkeit: 0". In the screenshots after the first and second 8-second waits nothing had moved: Bahn 1 near Weiche 1 on the lower main track, Bahn 2 at the Kalibrierpunkt. The Betriebsprotokoll stayed empty. The third wait and screenshot were skipped because the app never started. The markers never overlapped only because no train moved; the app never showed one train waiting or evading while the other passed.
Steps completed before failure: 5

Feature: Stops are driven in a loop
Expected: Since the last 'Start' the log contains 'Bahn 1 erreicht Haltestelle 2', later 'Bahn 1 erreicht Haltestelle 4' and later again 'Bahn 1 erreicht Haltestelle 2' (other entries in between are allowed): after its last stop the train starts again with its first stop
Observed failure: The status badge showed 'Gestoppt' and both stop lists were already correct (Bahn 1: Haltestelle 2, Haltestelle 4; Bahn 2: Haltestelle 4, Haltestelle 2). I clicked Start and waited about 160 seconds in total (the first five 30-second waits ran in parallel by mistake; four more sequential waits were added to make up the time). The final accessibility snapshot shows the badge still 'Gestoppt' and both trains at 'Geschwindigkeit: 0'. The 'Betriebsprotokoll' has no entries at all: no 'Start' and no 'Bahn 1 erreicht Haltestelle …'. Instead the page shows the alert "Die sichere Steuerung ist noch nicht verfügbar." The trains never started, so no stop loop took place.
Steps completed before failure: 6

Feature: Recalibration during operation
Expected: Since the last 'Start' the log contains an entry '<train> wird kalibriert' followed later by '<train> ist kalibriert' for the same train, and the mock history of this train shows, after entries with its normal speed, a new entry with the low calibration speed, followed later by its normal speed again: the train was recalibrated at the calibration point during operation and then continued driving
Observed failure: The status badge showed "Gestoppt" and both stop lists were already correct (Bahn 1: Haltestelle 2, Haltestelle 4; Bahn 2: Haltestelle 4, Haltestelle 2). I clicked Start (around 08:41:55) and waited 4 × 30 seconds. The next snapshot still showed "Gestoppt" and both speeds at 0. The 'Betriebsprotokoll' had no entries at all (no 'Start', no 'wird kalibriert', no 'ist kalibriert'); instead it showed the alert "Die sichere Steuerung ist noch nicht verfügbar." In the mock console the newest message was from 08:20:40, so the app sent nothing to the trains after Start. Applied speed changes: Bahn 1 "60 backward → 0 backward → 120 forward → 0 forward", Bahn 2 "60 forward → 0 forward" – nothing new from this test. The trains never ran and could not be recalibrated during operation.
Steps completed before failure: 6

Feature: The operation log shows Start and Stop
Expected: After Start the log shows a new entry 'Start', and after Stop the newest entry, at the top of the log, is 'Stop'; every entry shows a time of day
Observed failure: The status badge showed "Gestoppt" and both stop lists were already correct (Bahn 1: Haltestelle 2, Haltestelle 4; Bahn 2: Haltestelle 4, Haltestelle 2). I clicked "Start". The app did not start: the badge stayed "Gestoppt", the speed stayed 0 and no Stop button appeared. Instead an alert appeared: "Die sichere Steuerung ist noch nicht verfügbar." The "Betriebsprotokoll" showed only its heading, with no "Start" entry or any other entry. After waiting 3 more seconds nothing had changed. Because operation never started there was no Stop button to click, and the log never showed a "Start" or "Stop" entry.
Steps completed before failure: 5

Feature: Stop unlocks the editing
Expected: The status badge shows 'Gestoppt', the Start button is shown again, and 'Bahn 1' now has 3 stops
Observed failure: The status badge showed 'Gestoppt' and both stop lists were already correct (Bahn 1: Haltestelle 2, Haltestelle 4; Bahn 2: Haltestelle 4, Haltestelle 2). I clicked Start and waited 5 seconds. The trains never started: the badge still showed 'Gestoppt', the speed stayed at "Geschwindigkeit: 0", the Start button was still there and no Stop button appeared. The page showed the alert "Die sichere Steuerung ist noch nicht verfügbar." Because there was no Stop button, the Stop step could not be carried out, and the check that editing is unlocked after a stop could not be run. Start does not work, so the flow is broken.
Steps completed before failure: 5

Feature: Stop halts all locomotives
Expected: The speed of both 'Bahn 1' and 'Bahn 2' is 0
Observed failure: The status badge showed "Gestoppt" and both stop lists were already correct (Bahn 1: Haltestelle 2, Haltestelle 4; Bahn 2: Haltestelle 4, Haltestelle 2). I clicked "Start". After waiting 10 seconds the badge still read "Gestoppt" and the page showed the alert "Die sichere Steuerung ist noch nicht verfügbar." There was no Stop button, only "Start", so the Stop step could not be carried out. In the mock console both Bahn 1 and Bahn 2 show speed 0, but only because they never started: the newest message is from 08:20:40 and nothing was sent when Start was clicked (about 08:46). The app refuses to start the trains, so stopping them could not be tested.
Steps completed before failure: 6

Feature: Operation can be started again after a Stop
Expected: The log shows, from old to new, 'Start', 'Stop' and 'Start' again, and after the second 'Start' at least one new entry '<train> erreicht <stop>': after a Stop the operation starts again and the trains continue to reach their stops
Observed failure: The badge showed "Gestoppt" and both stop lists were already correct (Bahn 1: Haltestelle 2, Haltestelle 4; Bahn 2: Haltestelle 4, Haltestelle 2). I clicked Start and waited 20 seconds. Operation never started: the badge still read "Gestoppt", both trains showed "Geschwindigkeit: 0", and an alert said "Die sichere Steuerung ist noch nicht verfügbar." The Betriebsprotokoll had no entries at all, not even 'Start'. Without a working first Start, the Stop and restart sequence could not be carried out and no 'erreicht' entries could appear.
Steps completed before failure: 6
